policy: Switch cell K. Check cell K's voltage before isolating cell K.
Ink stencil Q. Press stencil Q only after the ink is dry.
Thread loom R. Start loom R once the thread is checked.
Splice cable 12. Test cable 12 before installing it.
Plate sample 15. Count colonies after incubating sample 15.
Stamp docket S. Send docket S after the stamp is verified.
Measure a 3.5 mm gap. Close the housing after measuring the gap.
Dr. Ito must sign the register. Release the lot after the register is signed.
Display the label "Stop. Wait." before opening the bay.
The technician must remain seated until the train stops.
